$schema.description: Optional path to `pack.schema.json`, so editors offer autocomplete. Ignored by the app.

attribution.description: Credit and terms notes, e.g. which aircraft vendor's variables are read.

checklists.description: Checklist files, in display order, relative to the pack folder.

dependencies.description: Other packs this one includes, with the versions it accepts.

engine.description: App versions this pack works with, e.g. `>=0.1, <1`.

id.description: Lower-case id with dots and dashes, e.g. `ifly-737-max8` or `lib.boeing-cdu`.

license.description: SPDX licence id for the pack content, e.g. `CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0`.

schemaVersion.description: Pack format version; the app rejects packs newer than it understands.
